note: Hand-set pack sizes for foods where Open Food Facts is thin or wrong. Each entry replaces the OFF result and keeps its reason. share is null: these are not counts. portion: the USDA FoodData Central portion a loose unit is counted from (checked against data/raw/usda at build).

greek yogurt 0%.reason: Set by hand: only 4 OFF products with a size (two 1 kg tubs, two 6 x 125 g packs); 125 g is the single pot of those packs. Same sizes as plain Greek yogurt.

chicken breast.reason: Set by hand: OFF name matches mix fresh trays with cold cuts and cans (no size above 11%). 500 g and 400 g are the top fresh tray sizes in the OFF chicken-breasts category (4 products each).

ground chicken.reason: Set by hand: 9 OFF products, none with a size. 400 g follows the minced turkey trays in OFF; edit it to match your shop.

ground turkey.reason: Set by hand: only 2 OFF products with a size (400 g and 1 kg).

beef steak.reason: Set by hand: sold by weight at the meat counter. OFF sizes are variable weights or errors (4 with a size). Bought in 250 g steps at a price per kg.

fresh tuna.reason: Set by hand: cut to order at the fish counter; 7 OFF products, none with a size. Bought in 250 g steps at a price per kg.

frozen salmon.reason: Set by hand: only 3 OFF products with a size (200, 250 and 700 g).

dried parsley.reason: Set by hand: 7 OFF products, each a different jar size (8 to 60 g). A recipe uses a few grams.

lemon juice.reason: Set by hand: 4 OFF bottles with a size, all different (125, 250, 280 ml and 1 l). 1 ml counted as 1 g.

lime juice.reason: Set by hand: 1 OFF bottle with a size (500 ml); 250 ml follows bottled lemon juice. 1 ml counted as 1 g.

garlic.reason: Set by hand: bought by the head. USDA has 1 clove = 3 g (Garlic, raw, fdc 169230) and no head weight; one head counted as 12 cloves = 36 g. The OFF sizes (250 g 22%) are bags of several heads.

fresh parsley.reason: Set by hand: bought by the bunch. USDA has 10 sprigs = 10 g (Parsley, fresh, fdc 170416) and no bunch weight; one bunch counted as 50 sprigs = 50 g. The OFF matches mix fresh bunches with jars of dried leaf.

portion.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

spring onion.reason: Set by hand: bought by the bunch. USDA has 1 medium spring onion = 15 g (fdc 170005) and no bunch weight; one bunch counted as 6 = 90 g.

pumpkin.reason: Set by hand: bought as one small whole squash. USDA Pumpkin, raw (fdc 168448) has cup portions only; 431 g is the USDA whole acorn squash (fdc 168472), the nearest whole winter squash with a weight.

portion.food: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

sweet potato.reason: Set by hand: USDA's 5-inch sweet potato (130 g) is small next to the loose sweet potatoes in Spanish supermarkets; set by hand to a typical piece of about 300 g (estimate, not weighed).

broccoli.reason: Set by hand: USDA has a 151 g stalk and a 608 g bunch, but no head; Spanish supermarkets sell loose broccoli by the head, set by hand to about 400 g (estimate, not weighed).

lettuce.reason: Set by hand: USDA's romaine head is 626 g, larger than a typical loose romaine head in Spain; set by hand to about 350 g (estimate, not weighed).
